تقتطفوا (form VIII)
# تَقْتَطِفُوا (taqtaṭifū) /taq.ta.tˤi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# تُقْتَطَفُوا (tuqtaṭafū) /tuq.ta.tˤa.fuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
